desktop.notes:
• Faster: Canon photos make their thumbnails and previews about 2.5× faster with far less memory; Saturation and Vibrance move twice as smoothly; rating, labels and albums stay quick in a big Library.
• Welcome: an empty Library shows Add photos… / Add a folder… / Open a Library… (also in the Library ▾ menu) - Cullect is not needed to start.
• Words for any photographer: Settings → *What you photograph* goes into the AI's words; Hebrew is a choice (*Also write titles and stories in Hebrew*).
• AI helper: *Download AI models* in the app (one time, checked) instead of a developer tool.
• Safer updates: only updates signed by Curish are installed.
• Thumbnail cache keeps to 2 GB (oldest first); Settings shows its size with Clear.
• Problems: a log file, and Settings → Copy diagnostic info / Open log folder. An edit that cannot be saved when you close is told, never lost quietly.
• Edit: the toggle *Original* is now As shot (no crop, no adjustments - D); *Before* (hold B / Q) keeps your crop. Hold Q in the large view works; menus say Ctrl+B for the target album.
• iPhone photos (HEIC) are named when they cannot be added; place names with ' work as filters; Settings → Licences.
